_about: Hommlet's upper rooms (levels 8-16): agents of a hidden cult lodge above the village. Cultists help each other; Zert and Furnok are elites, Gundigoot a sub-boss, and the false Canon in the Chief Priest's Chambers, the cult's real master, calls his followers.

42300.name: cultist hooded
42300.long_desc: A hooded cultist checks the store-room locks, glancing over his shoulder.
42300.description: A plain villager's coat over a black robe, and an eye stitched inside the hood in red thread. The cult has eyes all over Hommlet.

helpers.shout: A hidden door bangs open: the cult comes!

42301.name: zert fighter
42301.long_desc: Zert the swordsman leans in his doorway, polishing a blade.
42301.description: A hard-faced man with a duellist's scars and the easy stance of someone who has killed for pay. He calls himself a traveller; no traveller carries that many knives.

helpers.shout: A hidden door bangs open: the cult comes!

42302.name: furnok thief
42302.long_desc: Furnok sits on his bed, shuffling a deck of marked cards.
42302.description: A small, quick man with clever hands and a pleasant smile that never reaches his eyes. He has picked half the purses in Hommlet and reported the rest.

helpers.shout: A hidden door bangs open: the cult comes!

42303.name: gundigoot priest
42303.long_desc: Gundigoot murmurs over a little brass eye on his table.
42303.description: A round, soft-spoken man who passes for a seed merchant. The brass eye he prays to is the sign of the cult he serves.

helpers.shout: A hidden door bangs open: the cult comes!

42304.name: assistant cleric
42304.long_desc: The assistant cleric looks up nervously from his prayer book.
42304.description: A young cleric of the village church who has begun to suspect his master. He jumps at every footstep.

42310.name: false canon
42310.long_desc: The Canon of Hommlet turns from the window, his kindly smile fading.
42310.description: Grey-haired and gentle-faced, the village's beloved priest for twenty years. Under the white vestments he wears the black eye of the cult, and he has been its master all along.

helpers.shout: A hidden door bangs open: the cult comes!

phases.message: The Canon tears off his vestments: "The Eye sees all!"

abilities.name: Unholy Sermon
abilities.telegraph: The Canon raises his hands, and his sermon turns to something dark!

abilities.name: Censer Blow
abilities.telegraph: The Canon swings a heavy brass censer!

abilities.name: The Eye Opens
abilities.telegraph: The Canon begins to chant to the Eye!

bosses.why: the false Canon in the Chief Priest's Chambers

mechanics.shout: The Canon calls: "Brothers! Sisters! To me!"

42390.description: A plain brown robe like a pilgrim's, until you turn it out and see the lining stitched with a lidless eye.

42391.room_desc: A loaf of brown bread lies here.
42391.description: A round brown loaf from the inn's ovens below, still faintly warm.

42392.room_desc: A small purse of dice lies here.
42392.description: A leather purse of bone dice, every one of them weighted. Furnok never lost a game at the inn.

42393.description: A narrow, sharply curved blade of good steel, its grip wound in black silk.

42394.room_desc: A heavy studded mace lies here.
42394.description: A short-hafted mace with an iron head ringed by studs, far too heavy for a merchant's guard to carry honestly.

42395.short_desc: a carved amulet of the hidden eye
42395.description: A disc of black stone carved with a single lidless eye, warm to the touch. The false Canon wore it beneath his vestments.
